title: On Jordan's Stormy Banks
print: The engraving SDAHImages 620.png (github.com/adventHymnals/SDAHImages, docs/seventh-day-adventist-hymnal/SDAHimages/620.png), read line by line on 2026-10-18. Four systems: bars 1-3, 4-8, 9-12 and 13-17, as the engraving numbers them. The stanzas are lyric rows 1. to 4. under bars 1-8; the refrain, marked Refrain, starts at the double bar in bar 9 and ends at the final barline. hymnal.db had "plain" where stanza 2 prints "plains" (it rhymes with "reigns"). Each line is as the engraving prints it, its syllables joined, its punctuation kept.

stanzas.text: On Jordan's stormy banks I stand,
To Canaan's fair and happy land,
O'er all those wide extended plains
There, Christ, the Sun, forever reigns,
When shall I reach that happy place,
When shall I see my Father's face,
Filled with delight, my raptured soul
Though Jordan's waves around me roll,

lines.text: I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.
